About Scripts
=============

MAPDRIVE.BAT        Allows quick partition allocation in Nextor via the MAPDRV.COM command.
TIMEIS  .BAT        Quickly displays the current date and time.
XSYS    .BAT        A useful script for exchanging MSXDOS2.SYS and NEXTOR.SYS on the fly.
